contract: D2 typed-reference matrix plus detail and handoff inputs, plus the D1.1 documents/files/entry input contract (guarded document section/hidden/expected_updated_at edits, scoped document search, the three file operations, team discovery and repository_path Project lookup). Each case is validated against the embedded catalogue by tests/schema.rs. These are the coordinated release/preparation contract, not a claim that an installed runtime implements every handler yet: the schema and examples are the agreed target shape providers code their handlers against, while an installed server only accepts what its own runtime advertises in discovery. Notes record server-side conditions (conditional inputs, replay rules) the JSON schema deliberately does not encode; all identifiers and permalinks are synthetic examples.

cases.note: Plain UUID reference with type; omitted detail keeps the current full behavior.
